_meta.adr: ADR-022 + ADR-037 — opt every PO-3-way lifecycle schema into OR's audit-trail-immutable capability (no app-local audit tables)
_meta.description: Member 11 of 11 in the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain. Overlays the slice-01 schemas (PurchaseOrder, GoodsReceiptNote, SupplierInvoice, ThreeWayMatch) with x-openregister-audit-trail: { enabled: true } so every lifecycle transition + saveObject is captured server-side by OR per ADR-022 D2. No app-local audit tables are authored; the AuditExportService aggregates from OR's audit log. The fragment is additive — disjoint keys on the same schemas union cleanly via SettingsService::deepMergeConfig().

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every lifecycle transition (draft → pending_approval → approved → sent → partial_received → fully_received → invoiced → closed / cancelled) and every approval-chain mutation is captured by OR's audit-trail-immutable abstraction. Actor is the authenticated user; the AuditExportService::generateAuditPackage consumer reads these records via OR's audit-log API (REQ-PO3W-010).

Every GRN lifecycle transition (draft → received → quality_checked → accepted / rejected) and every photo attachment is captured by OR's audit-trail-immutable abstraction. Captured photo references resolve to docudesk file ids in the export package (REQ-PO3W-010).

Every SupplierInvoice lifecycle transition (received → matched → exception → approved / rejected → posted → paid) and every saveObject mutation is captured by OR's audit-trail-immutable abstraction. The export package keys on the invoice id (REQ-PO3W-010).

Every ThreeWayMatch evaluation, exception classification and resolution disposition (accepted, credit_note_requested, rejected) is captured by OR's audit-trail-immutable abstraction including resolvedBy + resolvedAt + resolutionNotes (REQ-PO3W-010).
